$comment: Fleet roles -> cloud environments (#6887 phase 2, #7049). Skills, briefs and docs name a ROLE; only this file holds an environment id. Read it through tools/ci/lib/roles.mjs (resolveRole); `node tools/ci/brief.mjs role <role>` prints the id to pass to create_session. A renamed or rebuilt environment is a one-line edit here.

worker.name: I
worker.purpose: every launched worker session (ISSUE, CONTINUE PR, DEPLOY-RED, Gardener); never holds APEX_ROLE

orchestrator.name: f1-game orchestrator
orchestrator.purpose: the orchestrator session and its successor at rotation (skill handoff, Orchestrator ending); holds APEX_ROLE=orchestrator, never hosts workers
